title: Freehub body quick finder
description: Select your drivetrain brand and groupset to see which freehub body type is typically required. Always cross-check with the official compatibility charts from the drivetrain and hub manufacturers.
loadError: Compatibility rules are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
empty: Choose a brand and groupset to see a suggested freehub body type.
directInstall: Install directly; no spacer or adapter is required.
spacerRequired: Install a {thickness} mm spacer as instructed.

xdrXd.label: XD / XDR
xdrXd.title: XD and XDR are different freehub lengths
xdrXd.callout: Use a 1.85 mm spacer when an XD cassette is installed on an XDR body.
xdrXd.body: An XD cassette installs directly on an XD body. XDR is 1.85 mm longer, so the spacer belongs at the inner base behind the cassette.

shimano12.label: Shimano 12-speed road
shimano12.title: 12-speed road cassettes can fit HG-11
shimano12.callout: 11T-start Shimano road cassettes do not require a spacer on a compatible HG-11 body.
shimano12.body: Shimano 12-speed road cassettes use an 11T smallest cog and are designed to fit the standard 11-speed road HG interface.

shimanoDeoreM6100.label: Deore M6100 (12-speed MTB)
shimanoDeoreM6100.notes: Typical for Shimano 12-speed MTB groupsets like Deore, SLX, XT, XTR.

shimano105Di2R7100.label: 105 Di2 R7100 (12-speed road)
shimano105Di2R7100.notes: Shimano 12-speed road specific body; not compatible with older 11-speed-only freehubs.

sramGxEagle.label: GX Eagle (12-speed MTB)
sramGxEagle.notes: Use XD for Eagle 12-speed; NX Eagle cassette uses HG MTB freehub.
